'''''Bakkun''''' was a group of three [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Cargo ferry|cargo ferries]]. They were part of a convoy under escort by the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Stalwart (Victory-class)|''Stalwart'']] that was to deliver supplies and building materials to the [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] ''[[Ludwick]]'', with the intentions of establishing a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] called [[NL-1]] to restore order in the [[Pakuuni system/Legends|Pakuuni system]].
